ruleDefinitions.name: Payload Decoded and Decrypted via Built-in Utilities
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a built-in utility is used to decode and decrypt a payload after a macOS disk image (DMG) is executed. Malware authors may attempt to evade detection and trick users into executing malicious code by encoding and encrypting their payload and placing it in a disk image file. This behavior is consistent with adware or malware families such as Bundlore and Shlayer.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/openssl$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Volumes\\/.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*enc.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-base64.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-d\\ .*")))
